entities.summary: Oscar Rubén Larrauri is a racing driver from Argentina. He participated in 21 Formula One Grands Prix, all with the EuroBrun team, debuting at the 1988 Brazilian Grand Prix. He scored no championship points, only qualifying eight times. Oscar Larrauri was a architects & engineers from Granadero Baigorria (b. 1954-08-19, Granadero Baigorria). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
